name: The Broad
notes: Diller Scofidio + Renfro's Broad (2015) on Grand Avenue: the 'veil', a white lattice of cells over glass, drawn here as white fins and bands on every face; the concrete 'vault' of the collection store glimpsed through it; the veil lifted like a curtain at the two corners on Grand Avenue over the glass lobby; the oculus dimple in the Grand Avenue face; the olive-tree plaza to the south-west. On the downtown grid's bearing (front facing north-west onto Grand Avenue), rasterised in rows. Refined 10 Oct 2026 (no photographs; footprint, bearing, walls and height kept exactly, so the interior shell holds: check_interior 0 errors, footprint 89%): the roof's grid of glass dashes replaced by a north-facing sawtooth, glass slopes 2.4 m deep every 6 m with white backs, ridges along the building's long axis, never above the old 32.7 m; about 180 parts that lay outside the 100 m plate (a dark stair and a paving raster at y -93..., three trees) removed; a concrete plaza terrace laid under the olive trees. Dots stay about 33,000 (budget ~25k) because the plate is 125x125 at voxel 0.8 and the footprint may not change. Still guessed: size (about 64 by 60 m, 32 m high), the lattice pitch (the real cells are deep rhomboids), the skylight pitch and depth, the lifted corners and oculus, the plaza outline and which street is Grand Avenue.
